priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and pre-cast Glacial Spike or Frostfire Bolt before combat begins.
Use offensive cooldowns (trinkets, potions, and racials) when casting Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active, unless Thermal Void is currently active.
Cast Glacial Spike whenever you reach 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Flurry if you have charges available to prevent capping.
Cast Ray of Frost, provided that Frostfire Empowerment is not currently active.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler spell when no other priority actions are available.
If movement is required, use Ice Lance as a filler or Blizzard if Freezing Rain is active.
